SELECT T.TYPE_6 finprodType,
T.TYPE_9 type9, T.TYPE_10 type10, T.TYPE_11 type11,
FIN.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, FIN.VDATE vdate, FIN.MDATE mdate, FIN.TERM_DAYS termDays, FIN.CCY ccy, PA.RECOMMENDER assetProvider, RULE.BASIS basis, TRIM(DATE_FORMAT(RULE.YIELD*100,'90.9999')) loadRate, mcp.counter_id issuer FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_RECOMMENT PA ON FIN.FINPROD_ID = PA.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN mst_counter_party mcp ON mcp.link_id = FIN.ISSUER LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T ON FIN.FINPROD_ID = T.FINPROD_ID ,(SELECT FINR.YIELD,FINR.BASIS,FINR.EFF_DATE FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE FINR WHERE FINR.CASH_ID = (SELECT T.CASH_ID FROM (SELECT CASH_ID,UPDATE_TIME FROM FIN_CASH_INFO WHERE CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} AND CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2} AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} ORDER BY UPDATE_TIME DESC) T WHERE LIMIT = 1) ORDER BY EFF_DATE DESC) RULE WHERE FIN.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND LIMIT = 1

SELECT T.CLOSE_PRICE FROM ( SELECT M.CLOSE_PRICE FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE M
BASIS_CYY = #{basisCcy} AND TRADE_DATE < STR_TO_DATE(#{tradeDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND QUOT_CYY = #{quotCcy} ORDER BY TRADE_DATE DESC
) T
LIMIT = 1
